module.name: EKS Cluster CNEInstall
module.description: Apply the CNEInstance CR on AWS EKS plus the AWS-specific cloud-network-mapping ConfigMap and (optional) BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway, IPAM), and wire AWS IRSA for the CNE controller (IAM role + OIDC trust + SA annotation + rollout-restart).

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name and cluster_oidc_issuer_url for IRSA trust binding
FLO must be running and BNK CRDs registered before applying CNEInstance

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved from credential template (any auth method).

required.name: aws_secret_access_key
required.description: AWS secret access key. Resolved from credential template.

required.name: cluster_oidc_issuer_url
required.description: OIDC issuer URL of the EKS cluster.

required.name: jwt_token
required.description: F5 BNK JWT licensing token — bind to the same project secret the FLO module uses. Applied to the License CR (spec.jwt) by the license-activation-gate, which then gates on activation.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Empty for static keys.

optional.name: operator_namespace
optional.description: Operator namespace — FLO, License CR, OTEL/CWC. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-core. This module applies no resources here.

optional.name: instance_namespace
optional.description: Instance namespace — CNEInstance CR, cloud-network CM, NADs, IRSA SA, CNE controller. Gold-standard split: f5-cne-system.

optional.name: far_secret_name
optional.description: FAR image pull secret name.

optional.name: cluster_issuer_name
optional.description: ClusterIssuer name.

optional.name: flo_ready
optional.description: Dependency gate from FLO module.

optional.name: crds_installed
optional.description: BNK CRDs registered gate from FLO.

optional.name: instance_name
optional.description: CNEInstance CR name.

optional.name: deployment_size
optional.description: CNEInstance deploymentSize per F5 docs: Small (2CPU/4Gi), Medium (4CPU/8Gi), Large (8CPU/16Gi), Max (16CPU/25Gi).

optional.name: tmm_replicas
optional.description: Number of TMM replicas. 0 = auto-derive: min(availability_zone_count, worker_node_count).

optional.name: availability_zone_count
optional.description: AZ count from cluster-register, ceiling for the smart tmm_replicas default.

optional.name: worker_node_count
optional.description: Worker node count from cluster-register, caps the smart tmm_replicas default.

optional.name: watch_namespaces
optional.description: Namespaces the CNE controller watches.

optional.name: network_attachments
optional.description: NAD names attached to TMM, in order: [0] → trunk 1.1 (external), [1] → trunk 1.2 (internal).

optional.name: external_ifname
optional.description: External TMM ENI ifname (host-device env). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_ifname.

optional.name: internal_ifname
optional.description: Internal TMM ENI ifname. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_ifname.

optional.name: external_pci
optional.description: External TMM ENI PCI bus id. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_pci.

optional.name: internal_pci
optional.description: Internal TMM ENI PCI bus id. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_pci.

optional.name: external_selfip
optional.description: External TMM SelfIP (ext-vlan F5SPKVlan). Empty disables the host-device step. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.external_selfip.

optional.name: internal_selfip
optional.description: Internal TMM SelfIP (int-vlan F5SPKVlan). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.internal_selfip.

optional.name: selfip_prefixlen
optional.description: TMM SelfIP prefix length. Auto-wired from tmm-nads.selfip_prefixlen.

optional.name: tmm_az
optional.description: AZ of the single TMM node (single-AZ cloud-network-mapping). Auto-wired from tmm-nads.tmm_az.

optional.name: storage_class_name
optional.description: StorageClass for CNEInstance persistent state.

optional.name: cloud_az_subnet_mappings
optional.description: AWS AZ → subnet mapping. Auto-wired from eks-cluster-register — discovered via data.aws_subnet against the cluster's own VPC config.

optional.name: vip_cidr
optional.description: Explicit CIDR for BNK Gateway VIPs (single listener-network override). If empty and tmm_external_subnets_by_az is non-empty, the module auto-builds multi-AZ listener networks from the discovered subnets.

optional.name: tmm_external_subnets_by_az
optional.description: TMM external subnets per AZ, auto-wired from cluster-register (tag-discovered).

optional.name: bnk_gateway_name
optional.description: BNKGateway CR (kind: F5BnkGateway) name.

optional.name: vip_network_name
optional.description: Logical name for the VIP listener network in the BNKGateway CR.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where the CNEInstance CR lives.

key_outputs.name: cne_controller_role_arn
key_outputs.description: IAM role ARN assumed by the CNE controller via IRSA.

deployment.estimated_time: 5-10 minutes (waiting for CNE controller pod creation + rollout)
